POLICIES

Accessibility

Last updated November 19, 2026 · Version 1.0

We want everyone to be able to read and explore the Brewer family’s story. We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, Level AA.

What we do

  • Give images text descriptions.
  • Make menus and the questions section usable with a keyboard.
  • Reduce motion for visitors who turn on “reduce motion” in their device settings.
  • Check pages with automated accessibility testing when we make changes. We last ran this check in November 2026.

Known limitations

  • Some archival photographs and scans contain text that may not be fully described.
  • The archive video is hosted by YouTube; captions depend on the original publisher.
  • Linked websites, including news archives, are outside our control.

Tell us about a problem

If something on the Site doesn’t work for you, email brett@brewerfamilycompanies.com. Tell us the page and what happened. We will reply within 5 business days and, where we can, provide the information in another format.

Questions? Email brett@brewerfamilycompanies.com.
